card.title: 304. PANZERGRENADIER
card.text: Deployment: Gets +2+2 if the enemy HQ has taken damage this turn.
card.flavorText: The 304th Panzergrenadier Regiment was a regiment of the 2nd Panzer Division, an armored division of the German Wehrmacht that played a significant role in multiple campaigns during WWII. It was involved in the invasion of Poland in 1939, marking the beginning of the war. In 1940, the division took part in the Battle of France, pushing through the Ardennes and helping encircle Allied forces at Dunkirk. In 1941, it participated in Operation Barbarossa, the invasion of the Soviet Union, fighting as part of Army Group Center and advancing deep into Soviet territory. The division saw heavy combat around Moscow but had to retreat in the winter of 1941–42. In 1943, it fought at Kursk, the largest tank battles in history, where it suffered significant losses. Later in the war, the division was transferred to Western Europe to prepare for the Allied invasion. After the D-Day landings in June 1944, it was engaged in the Normandy campaign, fighting against the Allies in France. Later, in late 1944, the division participated in the Battle of the Bulge, a German counteroffensive in the Ardennes which failed to break through Allied lines. By early 1945, the division was heavily depleted but it kept fighting defensively as it retreated into Germany. It ultimately surrendered to US forces in May 1945 as the war came to an end in Europe. The 2nd Panzer Division, like many other German armored divisions, was noted for its aggressive tactics and experienced heavy losses throughout the war.
